missionSettings.description: SEAD in the MiG-29 Fulcrum: take off, destroy Boscali's four radar stations, deal with the fighters they send after you, then land at Agrapol and taxi back to the hangars. Mission by @calensk.11.

objectives.DisplayName: Go to the hangars and get out of the plane
